methodSections.heading: Crimini Mushroom Vinaigrette
steps: Slice the shallot and the mushrooms and then sauté in the oil in a saucepan until golden brown.
Remove from the heat and add the vinegars.
Season with the salt and allow to cool.
Blend the mixture in the food processor until it reaches a consistency similar to olive tapenade.

methodSections.heading: Bone Marrow
steps: Roast the bone marrow on broil in the oven cut side up, for 5-7 minutes. Using a cake tester, probe the thickest part of the marrow to see if it's cooked all the way through.
While the marrow is roasting, slice and then sauté the leeks and oyster mushrooms with the butter until tender.
Season the bone marrow and the mushrooms and leeks with the salt.
To finish, spread the Crimini Mushroom Vinaigrette on the Bone Marrow, top with the sautéed leeks and mushrooms.
Serve with the warmed sourdough bread.
